run_preprocess_generation: run preprocessing on NGS count data to compute enrichment factors and fiducial-comparison p-values
compute_pvalue: compute a p-value from a pooled t-test comparing an enrichment factor against a null distribution
drop_stop_codon_variants: drop variants that introduce premature stop codons from a mutation DataFrame
build_fiducial_enrichment_dfs: build per-fiducial enrichment factor DataFrames for comparison against variant activity
filter_and_score_variants: filter NGS variants by count threshold, compute enrichment factors, and annotate with hit labels
